info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v5-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback Retrieval API provides a means for users to access and review feedback related to job applications. This endpoint allows organizations to pull insightful comments and evaluations from their recruitment process. Typical consumers include hiring managers and HR professionals seeking to enhance their hiring strategies and improve applicant experiences. By analyzing feedback, teams can refine their candidate assessment processes and make informed decisions.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch feedback associated with applications. By making a GET request, users can access detailed feedback data, which can be utilized to improve the application experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve feedback related to applications. Please ensure that the request complies with the specified schema.
